shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣举着便携式气体检测仪，墙上有声光报警器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a portable gas detector in front of a wall mounted beacon and siren, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：气体检测与报警。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣捂鼻子摇头，指向检测仪
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot covers its nose, shakes its head and points at the gas detector.
shots.narration: 气体安不安全，鼻子说了不算。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰在气瓶间，墙上报警器闪红灯
shots.prompt_en: In a gas cylinder room a wall beacon flashes red and a siren sounds while the young male student looks around.
shots.narration: 阿杰在气瓶间，报警器突然响了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰嫌吵，伸手去关报警器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches up to switch off the alarm, annoyed by the noise.
shots.narration: 他嫌吵，想把报警器关掉。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他又凑到气瓶边去闻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans close to the cylinders sniffing the air.
shots.narration: 又凑到气瓶边，闻闻哪儿漏了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师在门口挥手让他出来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator waves urgently from the doorway for him to come out.
shots.narration: 王老师：别闻别找，马上出来！

shots.section_title: 为什么要检测：气体察觉不到
shots.scene: 有毒、可燃、缺氧三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a skull, a flame and a person short of oxygen. No text.
shots.narration: 气体危害三类：有毒、可燃、缺氧。
overlay: 为什么要检测：气体察觉不到

shots.section_title: 为什么要检测：气体察觉不到
shots.scene: 无色无味的气体，鼻子图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a colourless gas spreading in a room, a nose icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 很多气体无色无味，漏了也察觉不到。

shots.section_title: 为什么要检测：气体察觉不到
shots.scene: 检测仪读数取代鼻子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nose icon crossed out next to a gas detector with a blank display and a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 浓度高不高，要靠检测仪说话。

shots.section_title: 为什么要检测：气体察觉不到
shots.scene: 伤人，也损坏设备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an injured person icon and a damaged instrument icon beside a gas cloud. No text.
shots.narration: 泄漏伤人，也会损坏设施设备。

shots.section_title: 为什么要检测：气体察觉不到
shots.scene: 源头控制在前，报警在最后
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of barriers, a chained cylinder, a checked pipe, and last an alarm bell. No text.
shots.narration: 报警是最后一道防线，源头更重要。

shots.section_title: 固定式检测报警：监测、声光、联动排风
shots.scene: 固定式探头装在墙上，时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fixed gas sensor head on a lab wall with a round the clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 固定式探测器，二十四小时监测。
overlay: 固定式检测报警：监测、声光、联动排风

shots.section_title: 固定式检测报警：监测、声光、联动排风
shots.scene: 浓度条在危险线之前触发报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rising bar reaching an alarm line well below a danger line, a bell icon. No text.
shots.narration: 还没到危险浓度，就先报警。

shots.section_title: 固定式检测报警：监测、声光、联动排风
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室门口的气体报警控制器和声光报警器
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gas alarm control panel and a beacon with a siren mounted beside a lab door.
shots.narration: 报警时又响又闪，提醒所有人。

shots.section_title: 固定式检测报警：监测、声光、联动排风
shots.scene: 报警联动排风机启动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alarm signal line linking to an exhaust fan that switches on and pulls gas out. No text.
shots.narration: 还能联动排风，把气体排出去。

shots.section_title: 固定式检测报警：监测、声光、联动排风
shots.scene: 信号传到值班室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alarm signal travelling to a duty room where the security officer sees a flashing panel. No text.
shots.narration: 信号传到值班室和应急人员。

shots.section_title: 固定式检测报警：监测、声光、联动排风
shots.scene: 探测、报警、排风组成一个系统
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three linked boxes, a sensor, an alarm and a fan, in a loop. No text.
shots.narration: 探测、报警、排风，是一个系统。

shots.section_title: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置
shots.scene: 可燃、有毒、氧含量三种探头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three sensor heads each with its own icon, a flame, a skull and an oxygen symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 探测器各测各的气体，不能通用。
overlay: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置

shots.section_title: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置
shots.scene: 房间用什么气，装什么探头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hydrogen cylinder matched with a flammable gas sensor, a mismatched sensor crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 房间用什么气，就装测什么的探头。

shots.section_title: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置
shots.scene: 轻气体探头装高处，重气体装低处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light gas rising to a sensor near the ceiling, a heavy gas sinking to a sensor near the floor. No text.
shots.narration: 轻气体往上，重气体往下，探头装对。

shots.section_title: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置
shots.scene: 实验室、冷库、气瓶间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three rooms, a lab, a cold room and a cylinder room, each with a sensor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室、冷库、气瓶间都可能要装。

shots.section_title: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置
shots.scene: 按标准设置，安装经过验收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer installing a sensor with a rule book icon and an acceptance tick. No text.
shots.narration: 按国家标准和校规设置，专业人员装。

shots.section_title: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置
shots.scene: 选合格产品，证明齐全
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas detector box with a blank certificate and a tick, an unmarked box crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 选质量可靠、证明齐全的合格产品。

shots.section_title: 按所用气体选探测器、装对位置
shots.scene: 气体换了，探头跟着改
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new gas cylinder arriving and the facility engineer checking the sensor type. No text.
shots.narration: 换用新的气体，先查探头配不配。

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体房间装氧含量报警
shots.scene: 液氮、干冰、氮气瓶的房间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a room with a liquid nitrogen dewar, a dry ice box and nitrogen cylinders. No text.
shots.narration: 液氮、干冰、惰性气体，会挤走氧气。
overlay: 窒息性气体房间装氧含量报警

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体房间装氧含量报警
shots.scene: 【实拍】液氮间门口的氧含量报警器显示屏
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an oxygen level monitor display mounted at the entrance of a liquid nitrogen room.
shots.narration: 这类房间装氧含量报警器。

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体房间装氧含量报警
shots.scene: 氧含量低时报警，高时也报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen gauge with a low alarm zone and a high alarm zone, normal air in the middle. No text.
shots.narration: 氧少了要报警，富氧也危险。

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体房间装氧含量报警
shots.scene: 报警值按国家标准和本校设定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen monitor with a blank setting screen and a rule book icon. No text.
shots.narration: 报警值按国家标准和本校规定设定。

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体房间装氧含量报警
shots.scene: 报警时先离开，别进去找原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stepping back out of a door under a flashing oxygen alarm, entering crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 一报警，先离开，别进去找原因。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体看爆炸下限，远未到就报警
shots.scene: 浓度轴上的爆炸下限线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a concentration bar for a flammable gas with a lower explosive limit line marked by a flame. No text.
shots.narration: 爆炸下限：可燃气能被点燃的最低浓度。
overlay: 可燃气体看爆炸下限，远未到就报警

shots.section_title: 可燃气体看爆炸下限，远未到就报警
shots.scene: 低于下限太稀点不着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin gas mixture below the line with a spark that does not ignite. No text.
shots.narration: 低于下限太稀，点不着。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体看爆炸下限，远未到就报警
shots.scene: 报警点设在远低于下限处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alarm bell mark placed far below the lower explosive limit line. No text.
shots.narration: 报警点设得远低于下限。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体看爆炸下限，远未到就报警
shots.scene: 可燃气体检测仪读数上升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable gas detector with a blank display and a bar gauge rising from zero. No text.
shots.narration: 检测仪显示的是离下限还有多远。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体看爆炸下限，远未到就报警
shots.scene: 读数上升就停止作业撤离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rising detector bar and a person stopping work and leaving. No text.
shots.narration: 远没到下限就要报警撤离。

shots.section_title: 便携式检测仪：开机自检，随身佩戴
shots.scene: 便携式检测仪：单一气体和复合气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two portable gas detectors, a small single gas unit and a larger multi gas unit. No text.
shots.narration: 便携式检测仪，可以随身带。
overlay: 便携式检测仪：开机自检，随身佩戴

shots.section_title: 便携式检测仪：开机自检，随身佩戴
shots.scene: 【实拍】在室外清洁空气中开机，等待自检完成
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand switching on a portable gas detector outdoors and the display running its self check.
shots.narration: 在清洁空气中开机，等自检完成。

shots.section_title: 便携式检测仪：开机自检，随身佩戴
shots.scene: 【实拍】按键查看声、光、振动报警是否正常
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a thumb pressing a button on a portable gas detector, its lights flashing and the unit vibrating.
shots.narration: 确认声、光、振动报警都正常。

shots.section_title: 便携式检测仪：开机自检，随身佩戴
shots.scene: 按说明书用标准气做功能测试
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer applying a test gas cap to a portable detector, an instruction leaflet beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 按说明书和校规，定期做功能测试。

shots.section_title: 便携式检测仪：开机自检，随身佩戴
shots.scene: 【实拍】检测仪夹在衣领附近的呼吸带
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a portable gas detector clipped to a lab coat collar near the face.
shots.narration: 佩戴在衣领附近，靠近口鼻。

shots.section_title: 便携式检测仪：开机自检，随身佩戴
shots.scene: 进入前先在门口检测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person holding a portable detector at a doorway before entering a gas room. No text.
shots.narration: 进入可疑场所前，先在门口测。

shots.section_title: 定期校准维护，不遮挡不断电
shots.scene: 按说明书定期校准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer calibrating a fixed gas sensor with a calibration kit and a calendar. No text.
shots.narration: 探测器按说明书定期校准。
overlay: 定期校准维护，不遮挡不断电

shots.section_title: 定期校准维护，不遮挡不断电
shots.scene: 探头被遮挡、断电打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sensor covered with a plastic bag and a power plug pulled out, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能遮挡、断电，不随意拆。

shots.section_title: 定期校准维护，不遮挡不断电
shots.scene: 过期失效的传感器更换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old sensor with an expired calendar icon being replaced with a new one. No text.
shots.narration: 传感器有寿命，过期失效要更换。

shots.section_title: 定期校准维护，不遮挡不断电
shots.scene: 强制检定的按期送检
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a detector going to a verification lab and coming back with a blank sticker. No text.
shots.narration: 需要检定的，按期送检。

shots.section_title: 定期校准维护，不遮挡不断电
shots.scene: 校准检查登记记录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank logbook with tick boxes beside a gas detector. No text.
shots.narration: 校准和检查，都要做好记录。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 报警响，立即停止操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops her experiment as a wall beacon flashes.
shots.narration: 报警一响，立即停下手里的操作。
overlay: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 闻、找漏点打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person sniffing and searching around cylinders under a flashing alarm, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不闻、不找，不进去查看。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 返回关阀打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person running back to close a cylinder valve under an alarm, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不冒险返回关阀。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 可燃气体报警，开关电器打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable gas alarm with a light switch and a flame, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃气体报警，不开关电器、不动火。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 关门隔离，门口提醒别人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the lab door and holds up a hand to stop others entering.
shots.narration: 撤出后关门隔离，提醒别人别进。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 嫌吵关掉报警器打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off a sounding alarm, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能嫌吵就关掉，先查原因。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 报告负责人和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow chain from a phone to the lab supervisor and the security office. No text.
shots.narration: 报告负责人和保卫处，等专业处置。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 有人倒下：拨119、120，不冲进去
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person collapsed inside a gas room, a rescuer at the door dialling, rushing in crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 有人倒下，拨119、120，不冲进去。

shots.section_title: 报警响了：停下、撤离、报告
shots.scene: 专业人员检测确认后恢复
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer with a portable detector checks the room before giving a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 专业人员检测确认后，才能回去。

shots.section_title: 看风向标，往上风方向撤
shots.scene: 楼顶的风向袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wind sock on a pole above a building, blowing to one side. No text.
shots.narration: 风向袋告诉你，气体往哪儿飘。
overlay: 看风向标，往上风方向撤

shots.section_title: 看风向标，往上风方向撤
shots.scene: 往上风或侧风方向撤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas cloud drifting downwind and people walking upwind and crosswind away from it. No text.
shots.narration: 往上风或侧风方向撤。

shots.section_title: 看风向标，往上风方向撤
shots.scene: 顺风跑、躲低处打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person running downwind with the cloud and another hiding in a ditch, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别顺着风跑，也别往低处躲。

shots.section_title: 看风向标，往上风方向撤
shots.scene: 到集合点清点人数，报告
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator counts students at an assembly point and phones the security office.
shots.narration: 到集合点清点人数，马上报告。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 按气体选探头、装对位置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three sensor icons placed high and low in a room. No text.
shots.narration: 按气体选探头，装对位置。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 定期校准、开机自检
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a calibration kit and a portable detector with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 定期校准，便携仪开机先自检。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 报警：不闻不找，上风撤离，报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a nose crossed out, a wind sock with people walking upwind and a phone. No text.
shots.narration: 一报警，不闻不找，上风撤离报告。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一只冒白雾的液氮杜瓦挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a small liquid nitrogen dewar with white vapour and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：低温液体与干冰的危害。
